infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Veery uses the camera to scan business cards and QR codes.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Veery uses the microphone to record voice notes for new contacts.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Veery can import contacts from your address book.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Veery needs photo access to scan business cards from your library.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Veery uses Face ID to unlock the app instead of typing your PIN.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Veery to use the camera to scan business cards.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Veery to access your contacts.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Veery to access your photos.
